capabilities: Insert photos or albums into notes.
Convert pasted Immich URLs into embedded thumbnails.
Store images locally, remotely, or as shared links.
extras: Not yet in the official Obsidian community plugin list; a PR has been submitted and is pending review.
intentEvidence: I created this as an alternative to his Templater script.
motivation: The author created this plugin as an alternative to an existing Templater script.
problem: Users need an easy way to browse and embed photos from a self-hosted Immich server into their Obsidian notes.
summary: A photo picker that allows users to browse and insert images from a self-hosted Immich photo server directly into Obsidian notes.
